name: metamorfiles
description: On-brand social posts, ads and A/B variants in every platform size, designed by your AI agent and rendered on your computer.

interface.shortDescription: On-brand social posts, ads and variants in every size
interface.longDescription: Your agent makes your brand, or brings in the one you have, and designs on-brand posts, ads and print at every platform size on your computer. Templates come in when you want a design reused, varied or filled from a spreadsheet.
defaultPrompt: Use Metamorfiles to make an Instagram post and story for our spring launch.
Use Metamorfiles to create six A/B variants of our ad in every format.
